decision: Author a finished master in 3D; deliver pre-rendered complete states to the website.

firstDelivery.direction: One adult female master with credible anatomy, editorial studio finish and an identical fixed pose, camera, crop, materials and lighting across states.
firstDelivery.geometry: Anatomically authored sculpt targets; preserve the master topology and correct overlapping effects manually. Rejected formula-generated shapes are not final targets.
firstDelivery.review: Judge contour and anatomy before surface detail. Distinguish volume increase, volume reduction and elevation. Inspect at actual desktop and mobile sizes.

continuation.generationRule: Up to three selections from three body procedures and at most one of three breast procedures.

baselineDirection.body: Moderately fuller, soft abdomen and flanks; less cinched waist.
baselineDirection.breast: Moderate overall volume with deflated upper pole, lower position and descending lower pole.

baselineDirection.consistency: Keep this same body in every breast-only variant; chest procedures do not also change waist, abdomen or buttocks.
